name: Kogure Fumika
source:
[url=/c1084]Aoi[/url]'s manager in the entertainment industry. Even though she looks like a tough career woman, her personality is soft and trusting. Aoi can always use this trait of hers in order to skip events by telling Fumika that her stomach hurts.

Hobbies: Reading.
Favorite Food: Edible wild plant dishes.

[Translated from [url=http://www.purplesoftware.jp/products/akiiro/chara.html]Akiiro Renka's official website[/url].]
